name: Climb Lounge
research_notes: Second pass 2026-10-06. The first pass read only the Naver Place text; the owner-uploaded business photos on the same listing settle bouldering. Two interior photos (uploaded 2022-12-22, files IMG_9713 and IMG_9719 on ldb-phinf.pstatic.net) show tall plywood walls with a crash-mat floor, no ropes or quickdraws, numbered problem tags with 'Start' and 'END' labels on the holds, and a wall-side height scale marked JUMP!: a bouldering area. Price sheet photo uploaded 2026-04-03 (day pass 20,000, 5- and 10-visit passes, monthly passes, shoe and chalk rental) and a 'MOON PASS' (MoonBoard pass, 10,000 KRW) poster uploaded 2026-05-06 show the listing is kept up by the gym. Naver Place text itself is generic (climbing centre, lessons, day trial); live hours (weekdays from 11:00) with owner-set holiday hours; own Instagram bio hours and posts to 2026-10-02 (captions not legible to the fetch tool). Own blog has one post (2024-04-27, outdoor trip). Third party: Spirit lists a bouldering section. Types: indoor-bouldering only, no rope wall seen.

name: Hwasun Rock Climbing Center
research_notes: Second pass 2026-10-06. The first pass missed the gym's own blog (Naver blog cobo365, shared with the sister centre 광주락클라이밍센터 in Ilgok-dong, Buk-gu). Bouldering: own post 2022-10-14 ('진로체험(동복중학교)': pupils' career-experience day held at 화순락클라이밍센터, 'repeatedly attempting the difficult bouldering moves and clearing them'); own post 2021-11-19 ('화순락클라이밍센터 꼬맹 클라이머의 볼더링 아쉽게 온싸이트 실패 후 완등', hashtag 볼더링); own post 2022-09-23 lists bouldering and lead among the centre's hobby classes. The photos of the 2022-10-14 post were inspected: a group photo and a wall photo inside the centre show a low-ceiling room with steep wood walls fully covered in holds and a crash-mat floor, no ropes: a bouldering room. The posts date from 2021-2022, so today's set-up rests on them plus the Naver Place text ('실내암벽'). Open: Naver Place has live owner-set hours (13:00 weekdays, closed Saturday and Sunday, 2026-10-09 Hangul Day closure entered); own blog post 2026-04-03 (gym hiking group); own Instagram posts 2026-06-08 to 2026-09-27 (outdoor clips). Types: indoor-bouldering only; rope walls not shown.

name: Hwang Pyeong-ju Climbing Class

coord_source.ref: Naver Place pin 35.1235159,126.8616764; Kakao Map 35.12351676,126.861671 (about 1 m apart)

research_notes: Second pass 2026-10-06. Athlete-training academy ('스포츠클라이밍 학원', run by national-team coach Hwang Pyeong-ju), 2nd and 4th floor; sport climbing (lead, speed, bouldering), ice and dry-tooling training. Owner-uploaded Naver Place photos (2024-10-31, 2025-03-18) show a mat-floored hall with steep walls, numbered holds, campus-style training devices: a bouldering-type training room exists, but the gym itself says it is not a bouldering business. Own blog 2025-07-27 (setting report for the 4th-floor 'athlete village'): '볼더링 영업장이 아닌 지구력과 훈련을 위한 체육관의 특징을 살려서 세팅한다' (not a bouldering business; an endurance and training hall). Own blog 2026-07-04 (summer special course): 'Thursday: other gym's bouldering and speed, entrance fee separate' (bouldering sessions are held at another gym). Own Naver Place text mentions bouldering among seasonal discipline classes but lists no day pass or price (only a 'consultation' item). Open: live Naver Place hours (to 23:00, closed Sundays), blog posts to 2026-08-24, Naver clip 2026-09-26. Not settled: whether the public can walk in to boulder (see MANUAL-CHECK.md); bouldering left unknown, types empty.

name: Yeosu Climbing Gym

coord_source.ref: Naver Place pin 34.7587688,127.669891; Kakao Map (listed as 여수실내암벽) 34.75875892,127.66987405 (about 1 m apart)

research_notes: Second pass 2026-10-06. Settled from the owner-uploaded business photos on the gym's own Naver Place listing (the first pass read only the text). Interior photo uploaded 2021-06-01: steep white walls with volumes and holds, numbered and 'Finish' tape tags on the holds, crash-mat floor, no ropes: a bouldering area. Price sheet photo uploaded 2026-07-13 (membership 100,000/month, day use 20,000, trial with lesson 25,000, shoe rental 2,000) shows the owner kept the listing current three months ago; plus live owner-set hours (Tue-Thu 13-21, Sat 12-18, closed Sunday; holiday entries for 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-09 equal the Saturday hours and may be Naver defaults) and an active Naver booking for a day trial (25,000 KRW). Text: 'indoor rock climbing for children to adults; children learn by solving climbing problems (등반 문제풀기)'. Weak spots: no post by the gym since 2024 found (newest visitor review 2025-08-13, newest blog or cafe review 2024-08); the Instagram link on the listing is @yuuuth_ (private). A search listing shows that profile as 'Se-young, Yeosu Climbing Gym / OneClimb Suncheon': the same owner appears to run OneClimb (seed-1181 site, 50 km away, a different site). The public @yeosuclimbinggym account is named OneClimb, so it does not show the Yeosu wall is open. Spirit (third party) lists the gym under bouldering. Types: indoor-bouldering only.

name: Mokpo International Sport Climbing Center

coord_source.ref: Naver Place pin 34.8175323,126.4405657 (listing unmanaged); Kakao Map 34.81755768,126.44057349 (about 3 m apart)

research_notes: Second pass 2026-10-06. Municipal artificial climbing wall on Bujusan (opened 2012-05-05): outdoor speed and lead walls, indoor 12 m wall and, per directories, an indoor bouldering room created in 2023; opening hours and a 4-hour pass price (5,000 KRW, as of 2024-12-01) per Climbing TV (article dated 2024-11-26). Every statement about bouldering and opening comes from directories or articles; the centre's own Daum cafe (cafe.daum.net/mokposccenter, 'Mokpo Wall Class', 49 members) could not be read by plain fetch, and the Naver Place listing is unmanaged (no description, hours or posts). category is commercial-gym only as a placeholder: it is a municipal venue, so reviewers should treat it as a public-access check. Left unknown (see MANUAL-CHECK.md).
